explication: Vendure is a headless commerce platform. The principal workflow is an administrator or storefront client entering through the routed UI or GraphQL API, invoking commerce services, and receiving catalog, customer, order, and operational results backed by SQL state. The sampled sources also show fulfillment state transitions, plugin-defined handlers, asset storage adapters, metrics extensions, and buffered job storage. Several broad commerce modules are represented from documented capabilities and enclosing paths; their internal implementations were not sampled.
